HO00003387.title: The Death of Robin Hood
HO00003387.description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale

HO00003304.title: The Dog Stars
HO00003304.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included.

HO00003172.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
HO00003172.description: Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, Peter Parker has devoted himself entirely to protecting his city as a full-time Spider-Man.

HO00003181.title: Pressure
HO00003181.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

HO00003306.title: Fall 2
HO00003306.description: Overwhelmed by her sister Hunter's death, Jax (Slater) connects with Luce (Thomas), Hunter's fearless friend. To heal, they attempt the infamous plank walk of Mount Kwan in Thailand

HO00003298.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
HO00003298.description: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe

HO00003402.title: The Incomer
HO00003402.description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

HO00003371.title: Don't Look Back In Anger
HO00003371.description: “Don’t Look Back In Anger” charts Liam and Noel Gallagher’s triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live ‘25, one of the most anticipated rock ‘n’ roll comebacks of our time

HO00003180.title: The End of Oak Street
HO00003180.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together.

HO00003399.title: Holy Days
HO00003399.description: A young boy finds refuge with three delightfully eccentric elderly nuns at a run-down convent facing shutdown. A road trip like no other, Holy Days is a joyful comedy packed with heart, humour, and high-speed hijinks

HO00002993.title: The Odyssey
HO00002993.description: Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology

HO00003348.title: Tony
HO00003348.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

HO00003301.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
HO00003301.description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, Hacks) for resurrection

HO00003300.title: Coyote vs. Acme
HO00003300.description: After decades of being blown to bits by bombs, demolished by dynamite, battered by boulders, trampled by trains, tricked by tunnels, steamrolled by steamrollers, and hurled headlong off every cliff in the Southwest, Wile E. Coyote finally fights back.

HO00003429.title: 9 to 5
HO00003429.description:
Three female office workers become friends and plot to take revenge on their sexist boss.
Starring the late, great, Dolly Parton.

HO00003349.title: Ponyo (Subbed)
HO00003349.description: In a small town by the sea lives five year old Sosuke, high on a cliff overlooking the Inland Sea. One morning while playing on the rocky beach below his house, he discovers a goldfish he names Ponyo, her head stuck in a jam jar.

HO00003420.title: Leviticus
HO00003420.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

HO00003379.title: Practical Magic 2
HO00003379.description: Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

HO00003344.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark (45th Anniversary)
HO00003344.description: The year is 1936. An archeology professor named Indiana Jones is venturing in the jungles of South America searching for a golden statue. Unfortunately, he sets off a deadly trap but miraculously escapes.

HO00003359.title: Laputa: Castle in the Sky (Subbed) (40th Anniversary)
HO00003359.description: Pazu's life changes when he meets Sheeta, a girl whom pirates are chasing for her crystal amulet, which has the potential to locate Laputa, a legendary castle floating in the sky.

HO00003427.title: Unidentified Murder (Cantonese)
HO00003427.description:
Alien Alert!!!
An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiralled into a real tragedy

HO00003106.title: Minions & Monsters
HO00003106.description: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous & totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world & then banded together to try & save the planet from the mayhem they had created.

HO00003360.title: Laputa: Castle in the Sky (Dubbed) (40th Anniversary)
HO00003360.description: Pazu's life changes when he meets Sheeta, a girl whom pirates are chasing for her crystal amulet, which has the potential to locate Laputa, a legendary castle floating in the sky.

HO00003409.title: The Boxtrolls
HO00003409.description: A young orphaned boy raised by underground cave-dwelling trash collectors tries to save his friends from an evil exterminator.

HO00003182.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
HO00003182.description: Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control

HO00000748.title: The Gruffalo - 25th Anniversary
HO00000748.description:
A cunning mouse goes for a walk in the forest, and outwits a succession of predators.

This well-loved children's story celebrates its 25th anniversary this year.

HO00002990.title: Toy Story 5
HO00002990.description: The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime.

HO00003294.title: Vice Press Presents: The Princess Bride
HO00003294.description: While home sick in bed, a young boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.

HO00003382.title: Eddie Cochran: Don't Forget Me
HO00003382.description: The first official documentary on rock 'n' roll pioneer Eddie Cochran, made with the Cochran estate. Featuring rare archive footage and testimony from music icons, it charts his meteoric rise, untimely death at 21, and lasting legacy.

HO00003417.title: Space: 1999 4K Restoration Double Bill
HO00003417.description: A spectacular cinematic event for fans of classic science fiction, this Space:1999 double bill brings together the groundbreaking first episode, Breakaway, and the acclaimed second-season opener, Metamorph

HO00003390.title: The Summer Book
HO00003390.description: Follows the inspirational tale of a young girl and her grandmother spending a summer on a small, uninhabited island in the Gulf of Finland.

HO00003266.title: EXHIBITION ON SCREEN: James McNeill Whistler
HO00003266.description: In an era of great change and great beauty emerged the character of James McNeill Whistler. Considered by some to be one of the great innovators of 19th century art, he was a contemporary of the Impressionists, much admired by Van Gogh and Manet

HO00002925.title: NT Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses
HO00002925.description: Olivier and Tony® Award winner Lesley Manville joins Aidan Turner in a striking new staging of Christopher Hampton’s celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin.

HO00003331.title: The Transformers: The Movie (40th Anniversary)
HO00003331.description: Forty years later, it still hits like a truck. Experience THE TRANSFORMERS: THE MOVIE back on the big screen in 4K and relive the battle, the music and THE moment...

HO00003418.title: Resident Evil
HO00003418.description: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise

HO00003430.title: Queen at Sea
HO00003430.description: As dementia erodes a woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interest, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection, and autonomy.

HO00003437.title: April X
HO00003437.description: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her, ultimately descending into madness.

HO00003419.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore? + Livestream Q&A
HO00003419.description: Charting the Sheffield band's extraordinary journey from obscurity to cultural touchstone. Fusing footage from Pulp's biggest ever arena show with four decades of colourful, never-seen-before archival material

HO00003352.title: Princess Mononoke (Dubbed)
HO00003352.description: A beautifully realized tale of civilization versus nature, PRINCESS MONONOKE is a true epic by Japan’s master animator Hayao Miyazaki

HO00003410.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
HO00003410.description: With the help of his shamisen - a magical musical instrument – Kubo must battle gods and monsters to unlock the secret of his legacy, reunite his family and fulfil his heroic destiny.

HO00003406.title: Detective Pikachu
HO00003406.description: The story begins when ace private eye Harry Goodman goes mysteriously missing, prompting his 21-year-old son Tim to find out what happened. Aiding in the investigation is Harry’s former Pokémon partner, Detective Pikachu.

HO00003351.title: Princess Mononoke (Subbed)
HO00003351.description: A beautifully realized tale of civilization versus nature, PRINCESS MONONOKE is a true epic by Japan’s master animator Hayao Miyazaki

HO00003408.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
HO00003408.description: Charting the Sheffield band's extraordinary journey from obscurity to cultural touchstone. Fusing footage from Pulp's biggest ever arena show with four decades of colourful, never-seen-before archival material.

HO00003307.title: Heart of the Beast
HO00003307.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

HO00003385.title: Celtic Utopia
HO00003385.description:
After 100 years of partial independence, a bold new wave of young Irish artists redefine folk
music and reflect over the impact of their colonial history.

HO00003272.title: National Theatre Live: The Misanthrope
HO00003272.description: Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) plays the title role in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic dark comedy. Telling the truth isn’t always that simple. Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society
